thread:
oncall-bot: Pager alert for severity P1 - service: hosted-api - metric: 5xx_rate - region: eu-west-1. Spike started ~1781234500. Paging oncall @alex :rotating_light:

alex: Got it, grabbing the pager. Seeing 5xxs on inference-host-rw-eu-1, ~40% error rate. Repro: POST /v1/generate -> 502. Hoping it's a rollout but checking.

maria: I'm looking at model routing table, no recent deploys in the last hour from control-plane logs.

alex: Captured initial logs:

```
[1781234512] upstream error: connection reset by peer on gpu-node-42
[1781234513] tok=... latency spike, 95th 1.8s -> 6.2s
[1781234520] 502 returned by runtime-proxy
```

alex: Mitigation attempt 1: draining requests from gpu-node-42 and routing to fallback pool. Doing `infra route set --exclude gpu-node-42 --policy failover`.

jen: Tagging customers at risk: we have 12 active high-throughput keys hitting eu-west-1. I'll start a quick impact assessment doc and DM AE for top-3.

sam: I can spin capacity in dedicated pool for burst if needed. How long to stabilize after drain?

alex: Expect ~90s for in-flight KV cache to clear, then routing. Initiated drain at 1781234620.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-378 by alex. Priority=P1. Slack channel #incidents. Status=mitigating.

maria: After routing change error rate dropped to ~6% within 2m. Still seeing tail errors on small percentage of requests (legacy model variants).

lina: Posting provisional status page update draft: 

"We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting the Hosted API in eu-west-1. Some requests may return 5xx or experience increased latency. We are mitigating and routing traffic to healthy capacity; updates to follow."

alex: +1 to that. Add ETA: next update in 15m. I'll confirm exact impact window once we have metrics.

jen: Draft customer message for affected customers (short-form):

"Hi — we're experiencing elevated error rates in eu-west-1 that may affect your API requests. We've mitigated routing and are monitoring. No action required on your side. We'll follow up with the incident summary and any credit eligibility details."

prashant: On SLA credits eligibility — trigger conditions: continuous downtime or error-rate thresholds over billing window. Can we estimate impacted token-hours? Need start/end time and percent error per key.

alex: Logging timestamps: incident start 1781234500, partial mitigation at 1781234620, residual elevated error until 1781234900 when all nodes healthy. I'll export per-key error rates and top-customer list.

billing-bot: Noted. Opened billing ticket BILL-6634 for SLA/credits pre-check. Please attach impacted key list and raw metrics.

sam: I pushed an autoscaling burst to dedicated-pool-eu and validated fallback routing. No further capacity errors after 1781234860.

maria: Post-mitigation check: 5xxs back to baseline <0.5%. We'll keep monitoring 30m.

jen: Customer comms: I'll send the short message to the AE-run list for the top-3 at-risk customers, and queue broader status page update once we have full timeline.

alex: For handoff: I'm on the incident until 1781235000, then prashant will take over the next shift. Handoff notes: cause unknown (possible NIC flake on gpu-node-42), mitigations applied (drain+failover, autoscale burst), customer impact window 1781234500 - 1781234900, affected keys list will be uploaded to BILL-6634.

prashant: Acknowledged. I'll validate eligibility rules with finance: we need per-customer downtime *and* >0.1% of billed token consumption affected to consider credit. Will coordinate with billing team to estimate credit amounts.

lina: Status page final update going live in 5m: includes timeline + note that customers will be contacted with credit guidance if eligible.

jen: Template for individual customer outreach (to be personalized):

"Hi <CustomerName>,

We experienced elevated API errors in eu-west-1 between <start> and <end>. Your traffic saw ~<pct_error>% errors during that window. We have mitigated the issue and services are healthy. We will assess SLA eligibility; if eligible, we will apply a credit to your account and follow up with exact amounts. Please reply if you saw any downstream impact.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support"

alex: Action items: (1) alex -> upload per-key error csv to BILL-6634 (DEADLINE 1781235200), (2) prashant -> confirm credit eligibility rules with finance (DEADLINE 1781235300), (3) jen -> send targeted customer msgs and compile replies, (4) lina -> post status page incident summary when timeline finalized.

sam: I'll mark the runtime node for hardware diag and open a maintenance ticket for gpu-node-42.

billing-bot: BILL-6634 updated with attached CSV (pending alex upload). Finance notified.

alex: Upload complete. CSV: `impacted_keys_eu_1781234567.csv` attached to BILL-6634.

prashant: Reviewing. Based on initial numbers, three customers pass the >0.1% threshold and will likely be eligible for pro-rata token credits. I'll confirm amounts by EOD and create credit memos.

jen: Sent messages to the top-3 AEs with the template + impacts. Waiting on replies.

lina: Status page: live update posted (incident still mitigated; investigating root cause). Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-378

alex: Marking incident as mitigated at 1781234900. Leaving follow-ups in Triage channel for postmortem.

prashant: Taking over as oncall now for follow-up. Handoff summary: see pinned message above.

jen: Posting a short internal comms template for customer-facing CS and AE teams to reuse when replying: paste below.

```
Subject: Incident follow-up: eu-west-1 elevated errors (INC-2026-378)

Hi <Name>,

Thank you for your patience. We mitigated an elevated error rate that affected Hosted API in eu-west-1 between <start> and <end>. Our investigation shows the incident was caused by a transient infrastructure failure and we routed traffic to healthy capacity while we recovered.

We are assessing SLA credit eligibility now and will follow up with exact amounts if applicable. If you need any logs or further details for debugging, we can provide request-level traces for the affected timeframe.

Best,
Redwood Inference Support
```

prashant: I'll coordinate with finance and ops to finalize credit amounts and publish a short customer FAQ for common questions.

alex: Thanks everyone. Closing the urgent page. We'll run a postmortem next week and include recommended mitigations (improved node health checks, quicker failover path). :white_check_mark:
